summary: GDEV Inc., a BVI-incorporated gaming company reporting on Form 6-K, furnished its unaudited interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, prepared under IFRS. The filing includes segment disclosures, associate investments (notably Castcrown Limited), and subsidiary listings, reflecting routine quarterly reporting. No special-situation transaction—acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or similar—is disclosed. The document is a standard earnings release for a foreign private issuer, with no board recommendations, deal terms, or strategic actions. It maps to a routine earnings report under U.S. securities law.
